definition: Count of all deals in the pipeline, any stage.
name: Total Deals

definition: Deals in an open stage (Prospecting through Execution).
name: Open Deals

definition: Deals that reached Closed Won or Closed Lost.
name: Closed Deals

definition: Sum of enterprise/transaction value across all deals in scope.
name: Total Pipeline Value

definition: Deal value sitting in open stages only.
name: Open Pipeline Value

definition: Sum of expected fee (deal value x fee %) across all deals.
name: Total Expected Fees

definition: Probability-weighted fee forecast: expected fee x stage close probability.
name: Weighted Fee Forecast

dax: CALCULATE ( SUMX ( FactDealPipeline, FactDealPipeline[DealValueUSD] * FactDealPipeline[CloseProbability] ), DimStage[IsOpen] = TRUE )
definition: Probability-weighted deal value for open deals.
name: Weighted Pipeline Value

definition: Mean transaction value per deal.
name: Average Deal Value

definition: Mean fee percentage across deals.
name: Average Fee Pct

definition: Count of Closed Won deals.
name: Deals Won

definition: Count of Closed Lost deals.
name: Deals Lost

definition: Share of closed deals that were won.
name: Win Rate

definition: Share of closed deals that were lost.
name: Loss Rate

definition: Mean days a deal has spent since open (open deals) or until close (closed deals).
name: Average Days in Stage

dax: CALCULATE ( [Average Days in Stage], DimStage[IsClosed] = TRUE )
definition: Mean open-to-close duration for closed deals.
name: Average Days to Close

definition: Won deals as a share of all deals ever opened in scope.
name: Pipeline Conversion Rate

dax: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Total Expected Fees], DimStage[IsWon] = TRUE ), CALCULATE ( [Total Expected Fees], DimStage[IsClosed] = TRUE ) )
definition: Won expected fees as a share of all closed-deal expected fees.
name: Fee Realization Rate

definition: Mean expected fee on won deals.
name: Average Won Fee

dax: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Total Deals], DimStage[StageIndex] >= 3 ), CALCULATE ( [Total Deals], DimStage[StageIndex] >= 2 ) )
definition: Share of pitched deals that reached Mandate or beyond.
name: Mandate Conversion Rate

definition: Win rate among deals that reached the Execution stage or closed from it.
name: Execution Win Rate

dax: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Total Expected Fees], DimStage[IsClosed] = TRUE ), [Closed Deals] )
definition: Total expected fees divided by closed deals.
name: Fees per Closed Deal

definition: Count of active banker-deal staffing assignments.
name: Active Assignments

definition: Distinct open deals a banker (or group of bankers) is staffed on.
name: Active Deal Load

definition: Total allocated hours per week across active assignments.
name: Allocated Hours

definition: Weekly capacity hours for the bankers in scope (from DimBanker).
name: Capacity Hours

definition: Concurrent-deal capacity for the bankers in scope.
name: Capacity Deals

definition: Allocated hours as a percentage of capacity hours; >100% flags over-staffing.
name: Banker Utilization %

definition: Active deal load as a percentage of concurrent-deal capacity.
name: Deal Load vs Capacity %

definition: Bankers whose utilization exceeds 100% of capacity hours.
name: Over Capacity Bankers

definition: Bankers below 60% utilization (bench / under-staffed).
name: Under Utilized Bankers

definition: Active deal load divided by distinct staffed bankers.
name: Avg Deals per Banker

definition: Allocated hours divided by distinct active deals.
name: Avg Hours per Deal

dax: VAR Sel = SELECTEDVALUE ( DimStage[Stage] ) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( Sel ), [Open Pipeline Value], CALCULATE ( [Total Pipeline Value], DimStage[Stage] = Sel ) )
definition: Dynamic measure: pipeline value for the stage chosen in a slicer (SELECTEDVALUE), falling back to all open stages.
name: Pipeline Value Selected Stage

dax: CALCULATE ( [Weighted Fee Forecast], TREATAS ( VALUES ( UserAccess[IndustryGroup] ), DimIndustryGroup[IndustryGroup] ) )
definition: Weighted fee forecast that respects dynamic row-level security: users mapped in the UserAccess table (USERPRINCIPALNAME) only see their industry group's fees.
name: Weighted Fee Forecast Dynamic RLS
